grammar.explanation: Have got = có. Dùng để nói về sở hữu và bệnh tật. I/you/we/they have got. He/she/it has got. Phủ định: haven't got / hasn't got. Câu hỏi: Have you got...? / Has she got...?
grammar.explanationVi: Have got = có. Dùng để nói về sở hữu và bệnh tật. I/you/we/they have got. He/she/it has got. Phủ định: haven't got / hasn't got. Câu hỏi: Have you got...? / Has she got...?
lines: Have you got a stomach ache?
commonMistakes: Sai: 'I got a headache.' → Đúng: 'I've got a headache.' hoặc 'I have a headache.'
Sai: 'She have got a cold.' → Đúng: 'She's got a cold.'
Sai: 'Do you got a fever?' → Đúng: 'Have you got a fever?'

grammar.section: GRAMMAR IN USE · IMPERATIVES FOR ADVICE
grammar.explanation: Mệnh lệnh dùng để đưa ra lời khuyên sức khỏe: Take (medicine), Rest, Drink (water), Go to (doctor). Có thể thêm 'should' để lịch sự: You should rest.
grammar.explanationVi: Mệnh lệnh dùng để đưa ra lời khuyên sức khỏe: Take (medicine), Rest, Drink (water), Go to (doctor). Có thể thêm 'should' để lịch sự: You should rest.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'Take the medicine two times.' → Đúng: 'Take the medicine twice.'
Sai: 'You must to rest.' → Đúng: 'You must rest.' hoặc 'You should rest.'
Sai: 'Drink much water.' → Đúng: 'Drink plenty of water.'
practice: Go to the ___ if you feel worse.

dialogue.line: I don't feel well. I've got a headache and a fever.
How long have you had these symptoms?
Since yesterday. I also have a sore throat.
Yes, a little. And I'm very tired.
I think you have a cold. Take this medicine twice a day.
No, you should rest for a few days.
Drink plenty of water and stay in bed.

reading.title: Staying Healthy
reading.text: It is important to stay healthy. Here are some tips. First, eat healthy food. Eat more fruit and vegetables. Drink plenty of water. Second, exercise regularly. Go for a walk or ride a bicycle. Third, get enough sleep. Most people need 7-8 hours of sleep. Fourth, wash your hands often. This helps prevent colds. If you feel unwell, rest and take medicine. If you have a fever, go to the doctor. Don't go to work when you are sick. Stay home and get better.

review.summary: In this unit, you learned to talk about health and body parts, use have got for illness, and give health advice. Key phrases: 'I don't feel well.', 'I've got a headache/fever/cold.', 'Take this medicine.', 'You should rest.'
review.summaryVi: Trong unit này, bạn đã học cách nói về sức khỏe và bộ phận cơ thể, dùng have got cho bệnh tật, và đưa ra lời khuyên sức khỏe. Cụm từ quan trọng: 'I don't feel well.', 'I've got a headache/fever/cold.', 'Take this medicine.', 'You should rest.'
